criterion_text: Two distinct Manifests with the same EROFS Blob can enter separate Sandbox Sessions with different Env/targets without duplicate physical mount or premature unmount; old Session remains pinned after tag mutation.

verifiers.summary: Two distinct Manifests over one EROFS Blob entered separate Sessions with different Env/targets without a duplicate physical mount or premature unmount, and the old Session remained pinned after the Tag moved

evidence.value: exact SHA 1b266632e4eb385a156eed48a2cc0a8a086aaaa6: two Sessions of one EROFS layer kept distinct targets (/opt/node and /opt/rust) and distinct Config Env, shared one physical FUSE mount, releasing the first Session left it mounted, and the last consumer unmounted it

two distinct Manifests shared one payload and one physical cache file; the pinned old Manifest still resolved after its Tag moved; mount leases are keyed on the EROFS Blob digest, not the Manifest digest
